blurb: Piper & Heath Travel specializes in creating unique, custom safari itineraries in Africa, focusing on personalized service and detailed planning. They offer experiences such as walking and canoeing safaris in Botswana's Selinda Reserve, luxury lodge stays in Tanzania's Ngorongoro Crater, and wildlife viewing in Kenya's Samburu National Reserve. Their service includes itinerary design, booking, and preparation support for travelers.
extraNote: Nonrefundable deposit usually 25% of trip cost required to secure services · Final payment due 90 days before departure · Booking through Piper & Heath does not cost more than booking directly with camps
